ledger.pathEncoding: Machine-specific home prefixes are represented by portable root tokens; the original receipt and raw SHA remain authoritative for this execution.

ledger.runTimeTestProvenance: The router stamped the named test as UNTRACKED at run time. Subsequent content settlement does not turn this historical execution into an as-committed run.
ledger.recovery: Exact ledger receipt and saved raw/log were read; no test was replayed.

bundle.qualification: Disk bytes and the health-reported loaded build are separate observations; the disk hash does not establish the loaded bundle's full source graph.

measurements.responseInterpretation: The saved responses satisfy the bounded row shape; changing hashes under ambient writes do not establish response parity or equivalent intervention workloads.
measurements.definitions: PSS is smaps_rollup kernel kB times 1024. V8/Node heap, external and ArrayBuffer counters overlap with PSS and each other; they do not form a disjoint native allocation partition.

descendants.rawCounterDefinition: Despite its name, descendantCappedSamples increments per traversal visit excluded once remainingDescendants is zero; it is not a count of samples or a complete population census.
descendants.scope: Every sample reaches the cap. Descendant sums cannot be reported as complete service totals; descendants also include agent/runtime command trees, not only HTTP workers.

priorFailedRun.disposition: Preserved failed preflight: relative serving argv resolved against test-runner cwd; corrected to serving cwd before R2.

acceptance.supports: A saved build/PID/startTicks/executable-bound baseline on the actual current-build main process, with bounded ordinary HTTP probes, unforced idle windows and verified inspector cleanup.
doesNotEstablish: Complete service/HTTP-worker/descendant memory ownership or totals.

Unique native allocation bytes or allocator-fragmentation attribution.
